Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
#location of this script:
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
#get path to this project
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv(file.path(predictions_root, "predictions_2002_2011.csv"))

df$p_ignite_obs <- mapply(
  function(n_fires, n_strikes) {
    if (is.na(n_fires) || is.na(n_strikes) || n_strikes == 0) return(0L)
    n_fires/n_strikes
  },
  fire$fire_count,
  fire$n_strikes_obs
)
```

Make summary table
```{r}

pred_r_strike <- mean(df$r_strike)
obs_r_strike <- mean(df$r_strike_obs)

pred_strike_count <- sum(df$n_strikes)
obs_strike_count <- sum(df$n_strikes_obs)

pred_p_ignite <- mean(df$p_ignite_rate_cal)
sim_obs_p_ignite <- mean(df$p_ignite_obs)

pred_fire_count <- sum(df$fire_count_pred)
obs_fire_count <- sum(df$fire_count)

pred_burned_area <- sum(df$total_burned_area)
obs_burned_area <- sum(df$burned_area_km2)

summary_table <- as.data.frame(matrix(c(pred_r_strike, obs_r_strike, pred_strike_count, obs_strike_count, pred_p_ignite, sim_obs_p_ignite, pred_fire_count, obs_fire_count, pred_burned_area, obs_burned_area), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE))

colnames(summary_table) <- c("predicted", "observed")

summary_table <- cbind(model_outpit = c("strike_rate", "strike_count", "p_ignite", "fire_count", "total_burned_area"), summary_table)

summary_table_fmt <- summary_table |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ formatC(., format = "f", digits = 4, big.mark = ",")))

print(summary_table_fmt)


```




```{r}

# create a character vector of column names
var_list <- c("r_strike_obs", "r_strike", "n_strikes_obs", "n_strikes", 
              "p_ignite_obs", "p_ignite_rate_cal", "fire_count", 
              "fire_count_pred", "burned_area_km2", "total_burned_area")

#sum
total <- sapply(df[var_list], sum)

#mean
mu <- sapply(df[var_list], mean)

#variance
variance <- sapply(df[var_list], var)

#dispersion (mu/variance < 1; overdispersion)
dispersion <- sapply(df[var_list], function(col) {
  mean(col, na.rm = TRUE) / var(col, na.rm = TRUE)
})


# Combine as rows, then flip (transpose) into columns
summary_table <- data.frame(cbind(Total=total, Mean=mu, Variance=variance, Dispersion=dispersion))

# Convert to data frame so it is easy to work with
summary_table <- as.data.frame(summary_table)

summary_table |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ formatC(., format = "f", digits = 4, big.mark = ",")))

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# Your summary_table, with model names as rownames or a column
summary_table <- summary_table |> 
  rownames_to_column("row_name")

# Explicit mapping: submodel label -> observed row, predicted row
pairs <- tribble(
  ~submodel,        ~obs_row,             ~pred_row,
  "r_strike",       "r_strike_obs",       "r_strike",
  "n_strikes",      "n_strikes_obs",      "n_strikes",
  "p_ignite",       "p_ignite_obs",       "p_ignite_rate_cal",
  "fire_count",     "fire_count",         "fire_count_pred",
  "burned_area",    "burned_area_km2",    "total_burned_area"
)

# Long format: one row per (submodel, stat, obs/pred)
long_tbl <- summary_table |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Total, Mean, Variance, Dispersion),
               names_to = "stat", values_to = "value")

comparison_table <- pairs |>
  left_join(long_tbl, by = c("obs_row" = "row_name")) |>
  rename(observed = value) |>
  left_join(
    long_tbl |> select(row_name, stat, predicted = value),
    by = c("pred_row" = "row_name", "stat")
  ) |>
  select(submodel, stat, observed, predicted) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = c(observed, predicted),
    names_glue = "{stat}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  select(submodel,
         starts_with("Total"), starts_with("Mean"),
         starts_with("Variance"), starts_with("Dispersion"))

# Format for display
comparison_table |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ formatC(., format = "f", digits = 4, big.mark = ",")))




```
